review_candidates.title: Fullstack- AI Engineer, AI4ALL
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain end-to-end features across our AI framework — from backend services and agentic pipelines to the user-facing interfaces that expose them. Build and maintain frontend interfaces for internal AI tools and dashboards, working directly with the same APIs you build on the backend. Preferred Qualifications Experience with a cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP, or similar); hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) specifically is a big plus.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Hands-on experience with both backend and frontend development (e.g., Python/FastAPI on the backend, React/TypeScript on the frontend) — you should be comfortable owning a feature from an API endpoint through to the UI that consumes it, not backend or frontend alone. Practical, hands-on experience with generative AI / LLM-based systems specifically — e.g., building with LLM APIs, RAG, prompt engineering, or agentic frameworks; general/classical ML or data science experience alone does not substitute for this. Preferred Qualifications Experience with a cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP, or similar); hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) specifically is a big plus.
